name: aws
description: Read-only AWS access through the aws CLI: one MCP server (readonly-aws, own profiles; IAM user keys only, optional MFA session) and skills login (macOS key dialog into Keychain, 1Password optional), logout, profile and query (describe-/list-/get-/lookup-/search-* only; secret reads, credential minting, writes and global flags refused by the server; 1 MiB / 60 s caps, local query log without values). macOS only. Bundled: no npm install.
